71683-miscellanies.title: Nature, Addresses, And Lectures.
71683-miscellanies.creator: Unknown
71683-miscellanies.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It builds the sepulchres of the fathers. It writes biographies, histories, and criticism. The foregoing generations beheld God and nature face to face; we, through their eyes. Why should not we also enjoy an original relation to the universe? Why should not we have a poetry and philosophy of insight and not of tradition, and a religion by revelation to us, and not the history of theirs?

77966-spooky-hollow.title: A Fleming Stone Story
77966-spooky-hollow.creator: Carolyn Wells
77966-spooky-hollow.description: A book by Carolyn Wells. rock-bound forefathers left us a goodly heritage in New England. And, even though we may not still in awed tones call it holy ground, yet the soil where first they trod calls forth a certain respect and admiration not compelled by any other group of these United States.

arxiv-1712-06857.title: Measurement of the inclusive and fiducial t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} production cross-sections in the lepton+jets channel in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 8 TeV \sqrt{s}=$8\text{\,}\mathrm{TeV}$ with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1712-06857.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1712-06857.description: Abstract The inclusive and fiducial t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} production cross-sections are measured in the lepton+jets channel using 20.2 fb − 1 20.2\text{\,}{\mathrm{fb}}^{-1} of proton–proton collision data at a centre-of-mass energy of 8 TeV 8\text{\,}\mathrm{TeV} recorded with the ATLAS detector at the LHC.

Special thanks to Fedor Pakhomov; this paper is a descendant of our joint work. Thanks also to anonymous referees for their ve
arxiv-2107-03521.creator: James Walsh
arxiv-2107-03521.description: Abstract . There is no infinite sequence of Π 1 1 \Pi^{1}_{1} -sound extensions of 𝖠𝖢𝖠 0 \mathsf{ACA}_{0} each of which proves Π 1 1 \Pi^{1}_{1} -reflection of the next. This engenders a well-founded “reflection ranking” of Π 1 1 \Pi^{1}_{1} -sound extensions of 𝖠𝖢𝖠 0 \mathsf{ACA}_{0} .

arxiv-2303-07004.title: Incommensurable matter-wave jets in quasi-1D geometry
arxiv-2303-07004.creator: Tadej Mežnaršič, Rok Žitko, Katja Gosar, Jure Pirman, Katja Arh, Matevž Jug, Erik Zupanič, Peter Jeglič
arxiv-2303-07004.description: Abstract Matter-wave jets are ejected from a Bose-Einstein condensate subjected to a modulation of the interaction strength. For sufficiently strong modulation additional higher harmonic matter-wave jets emerge. Here we report the first experimental observation of incommensurable “golden” 1 + 5 2 \frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2} matter-wave jets in a Bose-Einstein condensate exposed to a single frequency interaction modulation.

arxiv-2310-01002.title: Diffusion-controlled reactions: an overview
arxiv-2310-01002.creator: Denis S. Grebenkov
arxiv-2310-01002.description: Abstract We review the milestones in the century-long development of the theory of diffusion-controlled reactions. Starting from the seminal work by von Smoluchowski who recognized the importance of diffusion in chemical reactions, we discuss perfect and imperfect surface reactions, their microscopic origins, and the underlying mathematical framework.

arxiv-2406-12088.title: Energy extraction from the Reissner-Nordström de Sitter black hole
arxiv-2406-12088.creator: A. Baez 1, , Nora Breton 1, , and I. Cabrera-Munguia 2,
arxiv-2406-12088.description: Abstract The energy extraction from an electrostatic black hole by the decay or splitting of electrically charged particles is analyzed. We determine the energetic conditions that make the extraction process viable and present a general expression for the efficiency in terms of the parameters of the electrostatic black hole and the decaying particles.

arxiv-2408-03718.title: A straightforward proof of the critical value in the Hegselmann-Krause model: up to one-half
arxiv-2408-03718.creator: Hsin-Lun Li
arxiv-2408-03718.description: Abstract . In the Hegselmann-Krause model, an agent updates its opinion by averaging with others whose opinions differ by at most a given confidence threshold. With agents’ initial opinions uniformly distributed on the unit interval, we provide a straightforward proof that establishes the critical value is up to one-half.

arxiv-2501-19058.title: Gravity Compensation of the dVRK-Si Patient Side Manipulator based on Dynamic Model Identification
arxiv-2501-19058.creator: Haoying Zhou 1,2 , Hao Yang 3 , Anton Deguet 2 , Loris Fichera 1 , Jie Ying Wu 3 and Peter Kazanzides 2,4
arxiv-2501-19058.description: Abstract \IEEEoverridecommandlockouts \overrideIEEEmargins INTRODUCTION The da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK, also known as dVRK Classic) is an open-source teleoperated surgical robotic system whose hardware is obtained from the first generation da Vinci Surgical System (Intuitive, Sunnyvale, CA, USA) [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2502-00266.title: MCM: Multi-layer Concept Map for Efficient Concept Learning from Masked Images
arxiv-2502-00266.creator: Yuwei Sun, Lu Mi, Ippei Fujisawa, Ryota Kanai
arxiv-2502-00266.description: Abstract Masking strategies commonly employed in natural language processing are still underexplored in vision tasks such as concept learning, where conventional methods typically rely on full images. However, using masked images diversifies perceptual inputs, potentially offering significant advantages in concept learning with large-scale Transformer models.

arxiv-2504-08682.title: Bayesian optimization for mixed variables using an adaptive dimension reduction process: applications to aircraft design
arxiv-2504-08682.creator: J. Morlier
arxiv-2504-08682.description: Abstract Multidisciplinary design optimization methods aim at adapting numerical optimization techniques to the design of engineering systems involving multiple disciplines. In this context, a large number of mixed continuous, integer and categorical variables might arise during the optimization process and practical applications involve a large number of design variables.

arxiv-2511-14414.title: PACEE: Supporting Children’s Personal Emotion Education through Parent-AI Collaboration CCS: Human-centered computing Collaborative interaction
arxiv-2511-14414.creator: Yu Mei, Xutong Wang, Ziyao Zhang, Yiming Fu, Shiyi Wang, Qingyang Wan, Qinghuan Lan, Chang Liu, Jie Cai, Chun Yu, Yuanchun Shi
arxiv-2511-14414.description: Abstract . Emotion education is a crucial lesson for children aged 3 to 6. However, existing technologies primarily focus on promoting emotion education from the child’s perspective, often neglecting the central role of parents in guiding early childhood emotion development at home.

britannica-1911-sill-edward-rowland.title: Sill, Edward Rowland (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-sill-edward-rowland.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-sill-edward-rowland.description: Article 'Sill, Edward Rowland' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. educationist, was born at Windsor, Connecticut, on the 29th of April 1841. He graduated at Yale in 1861, as class poet; engaged in business in California; entered the Harvard Divinity School in 1867, but soon left it for a position on the staff of the New York Evening Mail; and after teaching at Wadsworth and Cuyahoga Falls, Ohio (1868–1871), became principal of the Oakland High School, California.

pmc-10640814.title: Fractional Dosing of Yellow Fever Live Attenuated 17D Vaccine: A Perspective
pmc-10640814.creator: Clairissa A Hansen, J Erin Staples, Alan D T Barrett
pmc-10640814.description: Yellow fever virus (YFV) is a mosquito-borne flavivirus that causes over 109,000 severe infections and over 51,000 deaths annually in endemic areas of sub-Saharan Africa and tropical South America. The virus has a transmission cycle involving mosquitoes and humans or non-human primates (NHPs) as the vertebrate hosts.

pmc-11476162.title: Role of Ginger in management of nausea among patients receiving chemotherapy
pmc-11476162.creator: Zamin Abbas Syed, Ammad Fahim, Mahpara Safdar, Rafia Imtiaz
pmc-11476162.description: Objective:Cancer patients treated with chemotherapy often face variety of side effects, with nausea and vomiting being the most frequent. Ginger (Zingiber officinale), contains natural compounds that can speed up the metabolism and increase intestinal motility. It is traditionally used to treat gastrointestinal disorders.

pmc-11554846.title: Trends in brain MRI and CP association using deep learning
pmc-11554846.creator: Muhammad Hassan, Jieqiong Lin, Ahmad Ameen Fateh, Yijiang Zhuang, Guisen Lin, Dawar Khan, Adam A. Q. Mohammed, Hongwu Zeng
pmc-11554846.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Cerebral palsy (CP) is a neurological disorder that dissipates body posture and impairs motor functions. It may lead to an intellectual disability and affect the quality of life. Early intervention is critical and challenging due to the uncooperative body movements of children, potential infant recovery, a lack of a single vision modality, and no specific contrast or slice-range selection and association.

pmc-11616643.title: Heartland Virus Infection in Elderly Patient Initially Suspected of Having Ehrlichiosis, North Carolina, USA
pmc-11616643.creator: Alexis M. Barbarin, Teresa G. Fisher, Michael H. Reiskind, Carl Williams, Bryan N. Ayres, Kristen L. Burkhalter, William L. Nicholson
pmc-11616643.description: We report a patient in North Carolina, USA, with Heartland virus infection whose diagnosis was complicated by previous Ehrlichia chaffeensis infection. We identified E. ewingii–infected and Bourbon virus–infected tick pools at the patient’s residence. Healthcare providers should consider testing for tickborne viruses if ehrlichiosis is suspected. Ehrlichia chaffeensis and E. ewingii are tickborne intracellular bacteria that cause human ehrlichiosis (1).

pmc-11649500.title: Ganglioneuroma: a rare appendiceal tumour – case report and literature review
pmc-11649500.creator: Rakesh Quinn, Jodie Ellis-Clark
pmc-11649500.description: Ganglioneuromas (GN) are tumours of ectodermal origin, derived from the neural crest cells. Appendiceal GN are extremely rare, with only eight contemporary case reports in the literature. Being benign and indolent, the necessity of resection for GNs is often debated. However, obtaining tissue to confirm the diagnosis can be challenging, frequently leading to surgical resection.

pmc-13198505.title: Measuring Exposure to Gun Violence and Risky Behavior: Psychometric Validation and Analysis of the Gun Violence Exposure (Gun-X) Scale
pmc-13198505.creator: Kimberly J. Mitchell, Victoria Banyard, Patrick J. Guziewicz, Bruce G. Taylor
pmc-13198505.description: Gun violence is a critical public health problem in the United States, requiring improved strategies for early identification and prevention. This study introduces and validates the Gun Violence Exposure (Gun-X) Scale, designed to assess awareness of gun violence, threats, and risky firearm behaviors within social networks, including in-person and digital contexts.

pmc-13243878.title: What Drives Metal Artifacts in CBCT? A Comparative Study of Detector Types and Metallic Object Configurations
pmc-13243878.creator: Zahra Vasegh, Yaser Safi, Mina Iranparvar Alamdari, Katayoun Ghaffari, Mehdi Hosseinzadeh
pmc-13243878.description: BackgroundOne major limitation of cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) systems is the presence of metallic artifacts. Given the widespread use of metals in dental treatments and the diversity of CBCT designs, this study aimed to compare the effect of aligned and lateral offset detectors on metal artifact formation within the field of view (FOV).

pmc-13282738.title: WDR82 suppresses breast cancer progression by inhibiting ERK-driven chemokine expression and neutrophil infiltration
pmc-13282738.creator: Qinyi Yu, Jiang Yang, Fengjiao Lu, Wenxiu Liu, Zeyao Han, Yuanchao Bao, Xiaorui Xu, Jialei Xu, Wanfeng Gao, Boyi Cong, Yangyang Chai, Xuetao Cao
pmc-13282738.description: Elucidating tumor-intrinsic mechanisms orchestrating immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) and cancer immunoevasion is essential for overcoming cancer immunotherapy resistance and developing novel therapeutic strategies. WDR82, a member of the WD-40 protein family, exhibits context-dependent regulation of cancer with undefined role in breast cancer and immunosuppressive TME.

pmc-13329503.title: Characterizing ex vivo models for studying lipid metabolism in triple negative breast cancer
pmc-13329503.creator: Naruenan Wongreantong, Chloe A.K. White, Yong Jin Lim, Karla C. Williams, Thomas J. Velenosi
pmc-13329503.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Lipid metabolism drives cancer progression but is difficult to model using conventional methods. In vivo models provide access to circulating lipids, but are costly and low throughput, while in vitro models lack sufficient lipid availability in culture media. Here, we evaluate the chick chorioallantoic membrane (CAM) patient-derived xenograft (PDX) and tissue slice models as ex vivo cancer models of lipid metabolism in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) over a 9-day incubation period using lipidomics analysis.

pmc-13349291.title: Leveraging microcredentials for sustainability literacy in higher education: A case study of reflective thinking and learning impact in science
pmc-13349291.creator: Brittany Lee Vermeulen, Julie M. Old, Michelle C. Moffitt, Jen Dollin, Najeh Alsalhi, Najeh Alsalhi, Annesha Sil, Najeh Alsalhi, Annesha Sil
pmc-13349291.description: Microcredentials are becoming increasingly popular in higher education. Despite their growing popularity, there is limited exploration of microcredentials’ potential for lifelong learning and their role in sustainability education within curricula. Furthermore, the use of and evaluation of reflective thinking linked to science and sustainability within these online offerings is unexplored.

pmc-13379667.title: Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitors Following Acute Myocardial Infarction in Patients Without Diabetes Mellitus: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-13379667.creator: Muhammad Ahmed, Muhammad Hamza Shuja, Shajia Shakil, Huzaifa Ul Haque Ansari, Firzah Shakil, Muhammad Abdullah Naveed, Syed Atta Ur Rehman, Narmeen Shaikh, Syed Hassaan Ali, Haya Waseem Ansari, Faiza Sajid, Mustafa Murtaza, Muhammad Usman, Biruk Demisse Ayalew
pmc-13379667.description: BackgroundSodium-glucose transporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors have shown significant cardiovascular benefits in heart failure (HF) patients with diabetes mellitus or chronic kidney disease. However, their safety and efficacy in non-diabetic patients without HF presenting with acute myocardial infarction (AMI) remain understudied.MethodsDatabases including MEDLINE, Scopus, Cochrane Library, and ClinicalTrials.gov were queried through August 2025 to identify randomized controlled trials (RCTs).

pmc-13445654.title: Prediction models for postpartum post-traumatic stress disorder: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13445654.creator: Shaoying Zhang, Liping Kang, Shilai Yang, Xiaojuan Su, Rongjin Lin, Noorsuzana Mohd Shariff
pmc-13445654.description: BackgroundDespite the increasing number of studies on prediction models for identifying the risk of postpartum post-traumatic stress disorder (PP-PTSD), the quality and clinical applicability of these models have not been clarified yet.ObjectivesTo systematically review and appraise the prediction models for PP-PTSD.

pmc-13452984.title: Radiological follow-up after surgery for a giant pulmonary artery aneurysm
pmc-13452984.creator: Santiago A. Endara, Gerardo A. Davalos, Jaime R. Pinto, Vladimir E. Ullauri, Veronica M. Tapia, Juan A. Benitez, Daniel A. Freire
pmc-13452984.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pulmonary artery aneurysm (PAA) is a rare cardiovascular condition, with an incidence of 1 per 14,000 autopsies. It is defined as a dilation of the pulmonary artery trunk exceeding 4 cm. Due to the risk of lethal complications such as dissection thrombosis or spontaneous rupture, surgical management is imperative for “giant” or symptomatic aneurysms, although postoperative follow-up protocols are not standardized. A 68-year-old Asian female presented with a 6-month history of progressive chest pain and dyspnea.

pmc-13487605.title: Hard Exudates in Diabetic Macular Edema: Automated OCT Quantification and Longitudinal Response to Faricimab
pmc-13487605.creator: Giovanni Scalabrin, Francesco Perego, Matteo Capobianco, Daniele Veritti, Enrico Borrelli, Pasquale Viggiano, Giacomo Boscia, Francesco Bandello, Rosangela Lattanzio, Maria Vittoria Cicinelli
pmc-13487605.description: PurposeTo develop and validate an automated OCT-based pipeline for hard exudates (HEs) quantification and to characterize their longitudinal evolution in eyes with diabetic macular edema (DME) treated with faricimab.DesignRetrospective, single-center observational study.SubjectsTreatment-naïve and previously treated DME eyes initiating intravitreal faricimab with ≥2 visits and a minimum follow-up of 3 months.

pmc-13551223.title: Enablers and Barriers Among Women Ophthalmologists: A National Cross-Sectional Survey in Saudi Arabia
pmc-13551223.creator: Walaa Abdullah Aldairi, Hajar Mahmoud AlHajri, Abdulmalek W Alhithlool, Ossama M Zakaria
pmc-13551223.description: PurposeTo evaluate the self-perceived enablers and barriers among female ophthalmologists practising in health centres nationwide across Saudi Arabia. It also reviews their work-life balance, psychological wellbeing, experience of workplace discrimination, maternity-related challenges, and the personal and institutional factors that facilitate or hinder their professional and maternal roles.

pmc-13572871.title: Species identification, discovery, and biomonitoring: Strategic priorities for DNA barcoding in Europe, set in a global context
pmc-13572871.creator: Peter M Hollingsworth, Kasia Fantoni, Dimitris Koureas, Marine Arakelyan, Filippos A Aravanopoulos, Karolina Bacela-Spychalska, Liliana Ballesteros-Mejia, Pedro Beja, Georgi N Bonchev, Magda Bou Dagher Kharrat, Sarah J Bourlat, Tinatin Chkhartishvili, Fedor Čiampor, Filipe O Costa, Zoltán Csabai, Ga
pmc-13572871.description: The International Barcode of Life (iBOL) initiative is building a globally accessible DNA-based system for species identification and discovery. This paper outlines the mission and strategic priorities for the iBOL community in Europe (iBOL Europe), set in a global context.
